SET @a = 1
SELECT @a
PRINT @a

================================================================================
WHILE with BREAK and CONTINUE
================================================================================

WHILE (SELECT AVG(ListPrice) FROM Production.Product) < $300
BEGIN
    UPDATE Production.Product
        SET ListPrice = ListPrice * 2
    SELECT MAX(ListPrice) FROM Production.Product
    IF (SELECT MAX(ListPrice) FROM Production.Product) > $500
        BREAK
    ELSE
        CONTINUE
END
PRINT 'Too much for the market to bear';

---

            (number))))

        (select
          (function_call
            (identifier)
            (arguments

                (identifier))))

================================================================================
GOTO and labels
================================================================================

DECLARE @Counter int;
SET @Counter = 1;
WHILE @Counter < 10
BEGIN
    SELECT @Counter
    SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
    IF @Counter = 4 GOTO Branch_One
    IF @Counter = 5 GOTO Branch_Two
END
Branch_One:
    SELECT 'Jumping To Branch One.'
    GOTO Branch_Three;
Branch_Two:
    SELECT 'Jumping To Branch Two.'
Branch_Three:
    SELECT 'Jumping To Branch Three.';

---

(source_file
  (declare_statement
    (variable_declaration
      (variable)
      (type
        (identifier))))
  (set_statement
    (variable)
    (number))
  (while_statement
    (binary_expression
      (variable)
      (operator)
      (number))
    (block
      (select_statement
        (select
          (variable)))
      (set_statement
        (variable)
        (binary_expression
          (variable)
          (operator)
          (number)))
      (if_statement
        (binary_expression
          (variable)
          (operator)
          (number))
        (goto_statement
          (identifier)))
      (if_statement
        (binary_expression
          (variable)
          (operator)
          (number))
        (goto_statement
          (identifier)))))
  (label)
  (select_statement
    (select
      (string)))
  (goto_statement
    (identifier))
  (label)
  (select_statement
    (select
      (string)))
  (label)
  (select_statement
    (select
      (string))))
